writeup: Woot's Sellout has the EPOS EXPAND Vision 1M (model 1001197) open box for $66.49. It's a 4K video conferencing camera with auto-framing, a motorized privacy shutter and a wall mount in the box. Newegg lists the same model at $249.99, so this is about 73% less, and Woot showed only 2 left with a limit of 2 per customer.
